dedupe_keys.name: dataset for thresholds in road network functioning on us atlantic and gulf barrier islands

description: Environmental Dynamics Lab researchers publish road graphs for 103 barrier islands along the United States Atlantic and Gulf coasts. Zenodo supplies GraphML networks free under CC BY 4.0. Nodes and links represent drivable roads and intersections, with elevation and extreme-water-level information used to examine loss of connectivity. These graphs can support coastal-flood and transport-access simulations. Related G6 model-barrier-island-road-flood-threshold-analysis provides the processing workflow, while catalogue model-osmnx supports road extraction. Coverage is selected barrier islands; the associated network analysis focuses on graphs with at least one hundred nodes. Topographic uncertainty, water-level assumptions and omitted road characteristics constrain interpretation of functional thresholds. Acquisition dates and graph attributes were not independently checked. No GraphML files were downloaded or flood-removal experiments rerun.
